message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel chart comparing success rates across parallel and sequential scaling factors for three MaTTS configurations.","description":"A two-panel line-and-bar chart plots Success Rate (SR) against scaling factor k = 1–5. Both y-axes run from 36 to 56, with ticks every 4 units. In each panel, gray bars show “MaTTS w/o memory,” blue dotted lines with diamond markers show “MaTTS w/o aggregation,” and solid blue lines with circular markers show “MaTTS.” The values are printed next to the marks. In Parallel Scaling, the gray bars rise from 39.0 at k=1 to 42.2 at k=5; the no-aggregation line is 49.7, 49.7, 51.3, 52.9, and 52.4, rising through k=4 then dipping; the MaTTS line is 49.7, 50.3, 52.4, 54.0, and 55.1, increasing throughout and finishing highest. The two line series coincide at 49.7 at k=1. In Sequential Scaling, the gray bars are 39.0, 37.4, 38.5, 40.1, and 40.6, dipping at k=2 before rising; the no-aggregation line is 49.7, 50.8, 51.9, 52.4, and 51.9, peaking at k=4; the MaTTS line is 49.7, 51.9, 53.5, 54.0, and 54.5, increasing throughout and finishing highest. The line series coincide at 49.7 at k=1.
